rawContent: This is a thread I didn’t have the patience to create. Please also read #WomanpowerUnlimited and the Black Freedom Struggle in Mississippi by @drtiyimorris and get on out there and VOTE! It IS your ancestral duty and I’m sorry #BlackLivesMatter never told you that! #VoteNov6
